# Account Verification for Chatbot

Privacy-first account verification for chatbot. POY Verify confirms real humans behind every interaction without collecting personal data.

## Why Chatbot Needs Verification

As chatbot platforms digitize, they face the same trust challenges as every online business: fake accounts, bot automation, identity fraud, and deepfake impersonation. 64% of web traffic is non-human. Deepfake fraud exceeded $25 billion in 2025. Traditional verification methods (CAPTCHAs, phone verification, email confirmation) are all being defeated by modern AI and automation. Chatbot platforms need verification that proves the human themselves.

## POY Verify Solution

On-device biometric liveness detection. 30-second verification. Zero data collected. Two lines of code. Free for end users. Hardware 3D depth sensors, infrared analysis, and micro-movement detection confirm a living human is present - something no bot, deepfake, or synthetic identity can produce.

#### Quick Start

1. Install SDK (any language)
2. Add verification at signup or sensitive actions
3. Users verify in 30 seconds on their device
4. API returns verified/not-verified in under 50ms

## Zero-Data Architecture

No biometric data stored anywhere. No breach risk. No regulatory burden. No user privacy sacrifice. POY Verify's architecture makes it physically impossible to access biometric data - that is the design, not a policy pro

# World ID

World ID is a privacy-preserving protocol that lets people prove they are real and unique online without sharing personal information.

It gives developers a high-assurance trust layer to stop bots, duplicate accounts, and abuse — while keeping onboarding fast and user data off your servers.

Through credentials like Proof of Human, Document, and Selfie Check, World ID extends that trust layer with additional proofs without exposing underlying user data.

## Developer Quickstart

```tsx
import { IDKitRequestWidget } from "@worldcoin/idkit";
const rpContext = await getRpContext("verify-account");
<IDKitRequestWidget
  app_id="app_xxxxx"
  action="verify-account"
  rp_context={rpContext}
  // verify proof + nullifier on your backend
  handleVerify={verifyOnBackend}
  onSuccess={unlockFeature}
/>

```

## Credentials

Proof of HumanHighest-assurance uniqueness signal from Orb verification. Best for one-person-one-action flows and strong Sybil resistance.

DocumentProves possession of a unique government document through NFC checks. Useful for proof of age and document-backed access flows.

Selfie Check BetaLow-friction liveness and uniqueness signal from a selfie flow. Best for sign-up and bot defense where speed matters most.
